digest.component_or_area: Generated artifact identification and drift detection
propositions: Two JSON-formatted derived surfaces (index.json and criterion-pins.json) lack self-identifying markers, making it unclear to contributors that they are generated rather than hand-authored, leading to wasted CI cycles when contributors edit the derived files instead of their sources.
Plans and comments citing derived files by line number cause contributors to edit the wrong artifact, triggering drift gates and masking downstream test suite runs until stale files are regenerated.

A top-level _generated_by field must be added to index.json and criterion-pins.json as a fixed point emitted by their generators so that regeneration preserves the marker byte-for-byte and drift gates remain green.
The reserved _generated_by key must be explicitly skipped during catalog loading so that derived surfaces remain functionally identical to their pre-marker versions.

A centralized table in docs/README.md must document all nine derived/parity-gated surfaces with their regenerate commands and enforcing gates, with explicit flagging of hand-authored-but-gated files that must not receive banners.
New tests must verify that the documented table completeness is enforced (a missing row fails the test) and that both JSON markers survive regeneration identically.
